A.note: Saturated blue sky and sea, rocky textured mountain with a clear silhouette, dense town with terracotta roofs. Foreground white blocks and the flat grey runway look like a maquette. The pitch has a visible pattern. Strongest depth and contrast.

B.note: Hazy, desaturated look that lowers contrast. The mountain is a blurry white and green smear that looks like a low-res texture. Orange roofs pop against the bleached ground. The sea is flat. Atmospheric but muddy.

C.note: Nearly the same as A, with good colour and mountain texture. The distant headland is dark, close and hard-edged, so it looks pasted on and breaks the atmospheric depth. The blue sea is a bit more uniform.

D.note: Same hazy treatment as B, with even less colour in the sea and sky. The mountain texture is blurry. The foreground is bleached and the white blocks are toy-like. It has the weakest contrast and the least sense of place.

why: A and C have strong colour, contrast and a readable rock-city-runway layout, while B and D are washed out with a smeared mountain texture; A edges C because its distant headland sits naturally in the haze.
top_fix_for_best: Break up the flat grey runway and the white foreground blocks with texture, weathering, markings, vehicles and shadows. Add light haze, so the scene stops looking like a maquette. Add small detail such as aircraft, ships with wakes and people.
